functionalRequirement: The system shall allow staff members to develop staff reports for publication and distribution.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support all required report formats (e.g., PDF, DOCX) for 100% of specified use cases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to enable staff members to develop reports, necessitating full coverage of report formats.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide an intuitive interface for staff members to create, edit, and publish reports with minimal training.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves report creation and distribution, requiring ease of use for staff members.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must ensure that reports are accessible only to authorized staff members, using role-based access control (RBAC).
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves sensitive report data, requiring protection from unauthorized access.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modifiability: The system must allow for easy updates to report templates and formats without requiring significant code changes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves report creation, necessitating flexibility for future updates.

functionalRequirement: User shall be guided to a login page after successfully registering, where they can enter their credentials to access the application.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must redirect users to the login page within 2 seconds after successful registration.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires a seamless transition from registration to login for user convenience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The login page must load in less than 1 second for 99.9% of users under normal load conditions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interaction with the login page, requiring fast response times.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: The system must verify user credentials using secure hashing algorithms (e.g., bcrypt) before granting access.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user authentication, requiring secure credential verification.

functionalRequirement: System shall ensure that dataset instances of a type created during app deployment start using the new code when a new version of the dataset type is deployed.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must handle dataset type version transitions without data loss or corruption for 100% of instances.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires seamless transitions to new dataset type versions, necessitating fault tolerance.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modifiability: The system must allow for updates to dataset type definitions with minimal downtime (less than 1 minute).
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves deploying new dataset type versions, requiring ease of updates.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Capacity: The system must support up to 10,000 dataset instances transitioning to new versions simultaneously without performance degradation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves handling multiple dataset instances, requiring scalability.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow site administrators to create news articles with designated publishing dates and expiry dates.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must ensure that news articles are published and expired exactly at the designated dates and times for 100% of cases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires precise control over article publishing and expiry, necessitating correctness.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide a user-friendly interface for site administrators to set and modify publishing and expiry dates.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves article creation and scheduling, requiring ease of use for administrators.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must ensure that news articles are accessible to users 99.99% of the time during their active period.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves article availability, requiring high reliability.

functionalRequirement: User shall be able to create a Gmail account by providing personal details like name, gender, password, mobile number, and location.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support all required personal details (name, gender, password, mobile number, location) for account creation in 100% of cases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to collect and process all specified personal details, necessitating completeness.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt all personal details using AES-256 during transmission and storage.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves sensitive personal data, requiring protection from unauthorized access.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must validate all input fields (e.g., password strength, valid mobile number) before account creation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user input, requiring safeguards against errors.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must complete the account creation process in less than 3 seconds for 99.9% of users.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interaction, requiring fast response times for a smooth experience.
